content.text:
I added the /partners gate in [I:/Scratch/_trimtest/T4-A-5/proxy.ts](proxy.ts), as Gate 2c after the /client-docs gate. Nothing is committed: `git status` shows only `proxy.ts` modified.

It works the same way as the /client gate. It reads the `sol_client` cookie and checks it with `verifyClientSessionEdge`. With no valid session, the visitor is redirected to `/client/login`. It matches the path in all the forms the other gates use (raw, decoded and normalised), so an encoded path can't get round it.

Typecheck reports no errors in `proxy.ts`. I didn't test it in a browser or running server.

Three things to know before you rely on it:
- **Any signed-in client gets in.** The check needs a valid session, not a particular workspace, so every client can open /partners. If only some clients should see it, it needs its own slug or allowlist check.
- **After login, users land on /client, not /partners.** The login page has no "return to" parameter, so someone bounced from /partners has to navigate back there.
- **There is no /partners page in `app/` yet.** Signed-in users will get a 404 until one is added.
